examples.en: Two men riding on motorcycles opened fire on him.
examples.zh: 两个骑在摩托车上的人向他开了枪。

examples.en: She went on and on about her trip.
examples.zh: 她没完没了地谈她的旅行。

examples.en: From now on you can work on your own.
